title: Service Contracts: early termination notice, minimum run and shortfall basis by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference sets out the early termination figures of each Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts tier: the notice the customer must give, the calendar months of the term that must have run before the customer may terminate early, and the commitment against which the shortfall is assessed on early termination.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Notice (calendar days) | Minimum run (calendar months of the term) | Shortfall basis on early termination |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 30 | 3 | full term |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 30 | 6 | full term |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 60 | 6 | full term |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 60 | 6 | prorated to termination |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 90 | 12 | prorated to termination |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 90 | 12 | prorated to termination |

## What the shortfall basis values mean
- **Full term**: the shortfall is assessed against the full commitment.
- **Prorated to termination**: the shortfall is assessed against the commitment prorated to the termination.

## Quick questions
**How much notice does the holder of an AHL Regional Account Contract give for early termination?** 60 calendar days.

**How many months must an AHL Starter Service Contract have run before it can be terminated early?** 3 calendar months.

**Which tiers assess an early termination against the full commitment?** The Starter, Standard and Regional Account tiers; the Key Account, Global Account and Strategic Partner tiers use the prorated commitment.
